content.scenario: A manufacturer of a popular skin cream is found to have caused a false advertisement to be made, claiming the cream has anti-aging properties that it does not actually possess. This advertisement is prejudicial to the interests of consumers.
content.outcome: The manufacturer can be punished with imprisonment up to 2 years and a fine up to ten lakh rupees for causing a false or misleading advertisement that is prejudicial to the interest of consumers, under Section 89 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the punishment for false advertising?
